pages.text: David, a shepherd, wrote a song: "The Lord is my shepherd. I have everything I need." A good shepherd cares for every sheep.
"He lets me rest in green pastures. He leads me beside quiet waters. He gives me strength."
"Even when I walk through a dark valley, I will not be afraid, because You are with me. Your goodness and love will follow me all my life."

thinkAboutIt.title: Think about it
thinkAboutIt.text: God takes care of us like a good shepherd. Jesus said, "I am the Good Shepherd." We can talk to Him in prayer.
